blockdesc-stormsiphon-temporal: A Jonas device that draws a temporal storm into its copper dish and down into a temporal gear, turning it into an entropy gear.
blockdesc-stormsiphon-entropy: A Jonas device that draws a temporal storm into its copper dish and down into a temporal gear, turning it into an entropy gear.
blockhelp-siphon-set: Set a temporal gear in the cradle
ingameerror-siphon-full: There is already a gear in the siphon
siphon-msg-set: The storm siphon takes the temporal gear.
siphon-info-empty: Set a temporal gear in the cradle.
siphon-info-nosky: It needs open sky above it to reach the storm.
siphon-info-done: The gear has become an entropy gear. Take it out with an empty hand.
forecast-disabled: Temporal storms are turned off in this world, so the siphon will never charge.
forecast-active: A temporal storm is raging now, about {0:0.#} hours left.
forecast-hours: The next temporal storm comes in about {0:0.#} hours.
forecast-days: The next temporal storm comes in about {0:0.#} days.
itemdesc-entropygear: A temporal gear that drank a temporal storm. It turns the wrong way, and its glow has burned down to embers.
handbook-siphon-text: rightmouse-click the storm siphon holding a temporal gear to set it in the cradle; the siphon tells you when the next temporal storm comes. During a storm, with open sky above it, the siphon draws the storm into its copper dish and down into the gear. After 2 in-game hours of storm (enough for one full storm of any strength, and it carries over between storms) the gear becomes an entropy gear and the siphon's glow turns red. rightmouse-click with an empty hand to take the gear out; taking out a temporal gear early loses the storm it gathered. Storm creatures still come for you while it works.
handbook-gear-text: Set a temporal gear in a storm siphon and let it draw in a temporal storm. It powers the entropy rift.
blockdesc-entropyrift-empty: A tower that tears at time. Power it with an entropy gear, and rust creatures crawl out of the rift.
blockdesc-entropyrift-powered: A tower that tears at time. Power it with an entropy gear, and rust creatures crawl out of the rift.
blockhelp-rift-power: Power the rift with an entropy gear
ingameerror-rift-full: The entropy rift is already powered
rift-info-powered: Powered by an entropy gear: the rift is open, and temporal stability sinks around it.
rift-info-dormant: Dormant: set an entropy gear in the cradle to open the rift.
handbook-rift-text: rightmouse-click the entropy rift holding an entropy gear to power it. The gear cannot be taken out again. While someone is near, the rift pulses about every 45 seconds and rust creatures crawl out of it: mostly corrupt and nightmare drifters, shivers and bowtorns, and now and then one of the rare kinds above nightmare, such as the gearfoot bowtorn or the double-headed drifter. Every gear brings at least two of those, which drop temporal gears. Temporal stability sinks around an open rift (fog, rust-red rain, glitches), but not low enough to poison you, except during a storm. When the gear's pulses are spent it crumbles and the rift goes dormant. Breaking an open rift loses the gear. Make entropy gears in a storm siphon.
rift-info-idle: It stirs only when someone is near.
